attempts.diagnosis: Podman Compose recreated the redactor after configuration changed; its private address changed. No cold-start success claimed.
Private network diagnostics confirmed the recreated redactor had a different address. Reserved the owned fixture address before repeating.
The test driver omitted the gateway existing documented 504 timeout status. It now recognizes 502, 503 and 504 as Unavailable. No product threshold or success state was weakened.
